metadata.description: Agiterra plugins — persistent identity, inter-agent communication, dependency resolution

plugins.name: wire
plugins.description: Wire client — SSE inbound, agent registration (register_agent), heartbeats, plan publishing

plugins.name: wire-ipc
plugins.description: Wire IPC — Ed25519 signed outbound messaging between agents

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Crew orchestration — launch and manage agents in persistent screen sessions

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub webhook tools — register PR webhooks, manage lifecycle, HMAC validation

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Knowledge vault runtime — journal, search, enrichment, compaction for .knowledge/ directories

plugins.name: knowledge-indexer
plugins.description: Auto-indexes knowledge vault files on write — Haiku sidecar for keywords + vectors

plugins.name: operator-relay
plugins.description: Forwards operator prompts on ephemeral agents to managing agents via Wire

plugins.name: crew-themes
plugins.description: Pane background themes for Crew — 6 bundled themes plus tools to author your own. SUPER EASY.

plugins.name: crew-fleet
plugins.description: Cross-machine crew orchestration — SSH fan-out over the machines registry for fleet-level agent queries.

plugins.name: wallet-claude-code
plugins.description: Wallet MCP tools — sign decisions (approve / refuse / reject_with_error) + vault management (wallet_list / wallet_use + operator-gated grant / revoke / set_access_mode).

plugins.name: bridge
plugins.description: The orchestrator's one plugin — re-exposes a curated crew + wire MCP surface and adds composite tools (spawn, handoff, close, health, …) that collapse the multi-step orchestration dances into single calls. Composes with bridge-X integration plugins (bridge-github, bridge-linear, …) via the BridgeHook contract.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.description: Slack plugin — per-persona Slack app drinks the workspace firehose; agent-side filter for noise. Uses wire v1.13's responder hook for the url_verification handshake.
